feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only the three original 0x975EE, 0x97727 and 0x977FB Sumo_Printf GOAL print E8 parents and existing finite GOAL D3DX batch owner. Do not re-enable crash-prone nineteen B9200 return hooks, or modify gameplay timer, +TIME, rank, SkyGlow, input, FFB, R26_SAFE, DX11 or frozen DXVK.

OutRunStagePrintfEnter splits a provably homogeneous previous D3DX batch before selecting ScreenHud, and Leave submits a still-homogeneous GOAL D3DX batch before restoring previous direct source; independently TagAppendedNodes propagates queued siblings.

Expand both finite original GOAL queued-Draw and direct-Flush producer predicates to OutRunStagePrintf, while protecting mixed/other owners with static asserts and portable C++ runtime smoke.

diagnosis.root_cause: Three original GOAL Sumo_Printf parent hook scopes already covered direct primitive dispatch and queued SpriteNodes, but an ID3DXSprite::Draw inside the original E8 may defer the physical GPU submission until a later Flush/End after source scope restored. The existing D3DX finite GOAL owner only recognized GoalTime020, GoalTime150 and ResultProgress, not OutRunStagePrintf.
source_trace: GOAL print calls 0x975EE/0x97727/0x977FB have hook enter and leave, direct ScopedExactProducerSemantic, and tagged SpriteNode children.
ID3DXSprite Draw accumulates a pending batch whose GPU Draw can be submitted by a later Flush or End, after parent scope exits; previous GOAL batch admission omits OutRunStagePrintf.
New R64 finite GOAL owner and both queue/direct predicates recognize this exact token, and direct GOAL enter/leave flush only trusted homogeneous pending batches under the matching original source.
alternatives_rejected: Hooking the nineteen original B9200 parents risks confirmed EIP crash at 0x97C5F/0x97E75 and does not prove deferred D3DX ownership.
Relabeling all ScreenHud or alpha draws to the GOAL plane could damage lens, SkyGlow, world stereo and completed results.
Flushing every global Draw defeats D3DX batching and allows unrelated sprites to be submitted under the wrong producer.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Exact original GOAL Sumo_Printf E8 scoped source now splits old D3DX batch before new ScreenHud provenance and drains only its own homogeneous batch before resetting the previous semantic; queue path recognizes the same exact producer.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Both semantic batch predicate compile-time static_asserts and portable goal_progress_owner_smoke.cpp cover matched, foreign, mixed, multi-draw after queue select, and nested queue cases. HMD verification remains pending.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: OutRunStagePrintf stays ScreenHud only during its proven direct or queued sprite GPU submission, leaving unchanged R84 per-eye transforms, existing result visuals, SkyGlow and non-GOAL world paths.
diagnosis.original_evidence: Canonical pinned OutRun 2006 executable identifies original Sumo_Printf GOAL result E8 parents at 0x975EE/0x97727/0x977FB, distinct from known unsafe direct B9200 family.
